'''Kord Murdok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he led a mercenary company, the [[Blaster Brothers]], across the [[Tularan Marsh]] until they were ambushed by [[nekghoul]]s.<ref name="Knight Fall" />
